6.204 rsCRIMultiStaticColumnsOrRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsCRIMultiStaticColumnsOrRows is a critical error that will occur when a CustomReportItem contains
at least two DataGrouping elements with DataGrouping.Static set to true along the same axis, such as
a row or column axis, but at different levels.
